claims.claim: New York Attorney General Letitia James and Governor Kathy Hochul filed a lawsuit against Polymarket on September 24, 2026, alleging it operates an illegal gambling business.
claims.source_title: Polymarket named in lawsuit filed by New York state
claims.supporting_quote: New York state has filed a lawsuit against Polymarket ( POLYMARKET ), alleging that it's running an illegal gambling operation in the state, New York Attorney General Letitia James and Governor Kathy Hochul said Thursday.

claims.claim: FAIR Canada CEO Jean-Paul Bureaud stated that prediction market contracts remain wagers in substance even if structured as derivatives.
claims.source_title: Investor advocacy group says existing prediction market restrictions should remain
claims.supporting_quote: FAIR Canada CEO Jean-Paul Bureaud says an event contract may be a derivative in legal form, but in substance it can still be a wager.
